title: Immersive VR Training for Fiber Optic Technicians
subtitle: XR · Enterprise

overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Sole experience designer on a Meta Quest 2 VR training program. Owned research, client discovery, storyline, interaction design, gamification, ShapesXR storyboarding, asset selection, sound design, and 7+ design documents through to final deployment.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Fiber-optic field work is high-stakes and costly to train in situ; technicians need safe, repeatable practice.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Owned research through deployment — gamified learning loops on Meta Quest 2, ShapesXR storyboarding, haptic-aligned steps, sound design, and 7+ design documents tied to real workflows.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Enterprise VR training that scales onboarding safely and retains procedural knowledge through play.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Designed for Millennium — Sole experience designer on a Meta Quest 2 VR training program. Owned research, client discovery, storyline, interaction design, gamification, ShapesXR storyboarding, asset selection, sound design, and 7+ design documents through to final deployment.
